title: BuildUpElement
description: One line of a region's build-up sequence. Matches engine-core's element primitives exactly (BASE, FACTOR, ADDER, PER_LINE) — CONSTRAINT lives in its own array, see constraint.schema.json, because the kernel applies constraints after the build-up, not within it.

basis.description: REQUIRED for FACTOR — ids of earlier build-up steps this factor is computed on. The engine refuses to run a FACTOR without one.

rate.description: Literal multiplier for FACTOR, e.g. 0.047 for 4.7%.

rateRef.description: Path into facts.elements to pull the rate from instead of a literal.

amountRef.description: Path into facts.elements to pull the amount from instead of a literal.

when.description: Conditional inclusion expression, e.g. "item.warehouse === 'US01'". An array of expressions is AND-ed together, for logic that branches on more than one field at once (e.g. China: origin of data AND supplier AND COO).

composite.description: Tags a FACTOR built from multiple regional sub-rates (e.g. China F&D).

allocatable.description: Set false on COMPOSITE factors per requirements §5.1.
